user.description: Choose a stable mosque ID (lowercase letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens). After setup, open Configure to add a timetable URL or upload a supported PDF/CSV.

error.invalid_mosque_id: Enter 1–64 lowercase letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter or number.

menu_options.import_url: Add or replace a URL source (recommended)

import_csv.title: Upload a CSV timetable
import_csv.description:
Upload a UTF-8 CSV, at most 512 KiB, with a header row and ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD) in the chosen year. Annual imports may be incomplete; missing dates and fields remain unavailable. Ramadan sources override annual data only on confirmed dates or with explicit manual activation.

{detail}

map_columns.title: Map CSV columns
map_columns.description:
Select the date column and the source column for each published prayer field. Leave unpublished fields unselected. Each column can be mapped only once. Check every suggested mapping. For the NMS annual layout, retain the labelled fields, Date and 24-hour format: its documented morning/noon/evening columns have already been normalized. General CSV and sample PDF times require HH:MM or explicit HH:MM AM/PM as selected. Jumu’ah congregations may use semicolon-separated times.

{detail}

import_url.title: Add a timetable URL
import_url.description:
Use a public HTTPS PDF or CSV URL. Downloads are validated and staged for review before approval. Select the documented PDF layout and printed year: NMS annual/monthly calendar pages, Zakariyya 2026 annual tables or its separate Ramadan page, or the synthetic sample table. Other layouts are unsupported. For CSV, the PDF layout choice is ignored. Ramadan activation requires separate confirmed dates or explicit manual activation.

{detail}

import_pdf.title: Upload a supported PDF
import_pdf.description:
Upload a text PDF no larger than 4 MiB (at most 16 pages). Select its documented layout and printed year. Use Annual for the NMS or Zakariyya annual calendar; the NMS monthly layout also supports partial calendars. Use Ramadan for the separate Zakariyya Ramadan page. Scanned/encrypted files and unknown layouts are rejected; use CSV instead. Approval stores the source; Ramadan settings control activation.

{detail}

check_updates.title: Check URL sources now
check_updates.description: Submit to check the configured URL sources. Valid changes will be staged for your approval. Existing timetables stay active. Automatic checks run daily while loaded. See the Source status sensor, or reopen Configure afterwards.

manage_sources.title: Manage URL sources
manage_sources.description:
{summary}

Removing a URL source stops future checks and leaves approved timetable data in place. Import another URL for the same kind/year to replace a source.

ramadan.title: Ramadan settings
ramadan.description:
Use confirmed start/end dates for automatic activation, or explicitly turn Ramadan on/off. Dates are inclusive (at most 35 days); adjustment shifts the active window, never imported row dates. Manual On stays active until changed and ignores the date window. Ramadan fields override annual fields only on matching Gregorian dates. If Iftar is unpublished, Maghrib beginning is used. Without a published Taraweeh time, the card shows “After Isha Jamaat”. Clear both dates to remove confirmation.

{detail}

publication_profile.title: Choose a supported publication edition
publication_profile.description:
These profiles cover only the named inspected editions. Enter the printed Gregorian year explicitly. They prefill layout, source kind and mapping; the next screen accepts a manual PDF upload. No timetable activates before review and approval. For different editions or editable source defaults, use the ordinary URL/PDF import route. Your mosque timezone is {mosque_timezone}; a profile never changes it.

{detail}

invalid_storage.title: Stored timetable for {mosque} could not be loaded
invalid_storage.description:
Salah Timetable found invalid stored data for {mosque} and stopped setup. The original stored timetable has not been replaced.

Restore a known-working Home Assistant backup, then reload the mosque integration from Settings → Devices & services. Keep a backup of the affected storage before attempting recovery. Removing the integration deletes its timetable data and is not a recovery step.

If a backup cannot resolve the problem, report the Home Assistant and integration versions with redacted logs to the project issue tracker. Do not publish original storage, source URLs or imported timetable content. This issue clears automatically after valid storage loads successfully.
